title: ML-Flask-app
summary: A Russian-language thesis (ВКР) project analyzing welding process data and building a Flask web app around a trained ML model. During the data-analysis phase, SDV's TVAE synthesizer is imported and run to generate synthetic tabular data, with sdv.evaluation.evaluate used to assess it.
